home.title: What is your land problem?
home.intro: Verified surveyors and land experts look at your papers and tell you the right way forward. Prices known upfront, no middlemen.
home.servingNote: Phone advice is available from anywhere in Bangladesh.
home.orTalk: Prefer not to fill a form? Talk to us directly
steps: Tell us the problem, on the form or by phone
We understand it on a free 10-minute call
We send a fixed-price offer, with government fees listed separately
After payment, a verified expert starts the work
trust: Verified experts, members of the surveyors' association
Price known upfront, government fees shown separately
You never hand cash to anyone
home.fasterNote: We don't promise to speed up government work. We help with the right advice, the right papers and field work.
